case_facts: A refrigerator I bought caught fire within a week from a manufacturing defect, damaging my kitchen; the company refuses to compensate me.

analysis.summary: A consumer purchased a refrigerator that caught fire within one week of purchase due to an alleged manufacturing defect, causing damage to the buyer's kitchen. The manufacturer has refused to provide any compensation for the product failure or the consequential property damage. This matter involves product liability, deficiency in service, and unfair trade practice under consumer protection law.

issues.issue: Whether the refrigerator had a manufacturing defect rendering the seller/manufacturer liable under product liability provisions
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 84 – Liability of Product Manufacturer

issues.issue: Whether the refusal to compensate constitutes deficiency in service and unfair trade practice
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 2(11) and Section 2(47)

issues.issue: Whether the consumer is entitled to compensation for consequential property damage (kitchen damage) caused by the defective product
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 83 and Section 89

issues.issue: Whether the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur applies to establish manufacturing defect without detailed technical proof
issues.governing_law: Indian Evidence Act 1872 / Common Law Doctrine – res ipsa loquitur

governing_acts: Sale of Goods Act 1930 Section 16 implied warranty

plan.esql: FROM legal-judgments | WHERE MATCH(text, 'refrigerator fire manufacturing defect product liability consumer protection compensation kitchen damage') OR MATCH(catchwords, 'product liability manufacturing defect deficiency in service') OR MATCH(title, 'consumer complaint defective goods fire damage') | KEEP title, headline, catchwords, text, date | LIMIT 10
plan.search_rationale: The query targets judgments involving defective electrical appliances causing fire and property damage, product liability under the Consumer Protection Act 2019, and refusal to compensate, using multi_match across key text fields with boosted weights on title, headline, and catchwords to surface the most directly relevant precedents and statutory interpretations.
